about_the_game:
Unleash skills with precision and feel the ultimate control—then let your auto-weapons sweep through hordes in a single blast!
Ebonor is a roguelite survival-action game that seamlessly blends manual skill casting with auto-attacking weapons. Play as the chosen survivor, battling waves of monsters across ever-shifting ruins and otherworldly battlegrounds.

  • Freedom to Build, Adapt in Real Time
    In every run, choose from dozens of passive weapons, diverse auxiliary skills, and upgrade modules. Swap, upgrade, or rebirth them on the fly in the shop. There’s no absolute best build—only the strategy that fits the moment: high-speed combos or ranged obliteration? Elemental chains or creeping poison?

  • Visceral Impact, Bullet-Hell Carnage
    Feel the heat of fire, the freeze of ice, the spread of toxic miasma with every skill cast. Auto-attacks rain down like a storm behind you, letting you focus on casting and dodging, delivering a true hack-and-slash spectacle.

  • Endless Replay, Deep Simulation
    Procedurally generated layouts, terrains, and enemy spawns keep the challenge escalating. Every death is a lesson in strategy; every victory, proof of your build’s power.

Step into this crucible of life and death—forge your legend through tactics and reflexes.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 Big Sur
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or more high
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus

short_description: Ebonor is a survival roguelike combining building with fast hack-and-slash combat. Weapons auto-attack, skill combos are free, and the pace is exhilarating—each run feels fresh. There’s no ultimate build, only the strategy that fits each situation to create your own system.
